facts.big: Can you + verbo base · I’ll + verbo base
facts.label: Pedir e prometer
facts.sub: Use Can you…? para pedir e I’ll… para prometer. Depois de can e will, use sempre o verbo base.

facts.label: Pedir favor
facts.sub: Para pedir um favor, use Can you + verbo base: Can you send it to me? Can you add a message? A resposta curta é Sure ou Of course. É um pedido simples e educado.

facts.label: Prometer
facts.sub: Para prometer ou oferecer, use I’ll + verbo base: I’ll send it now. I’ll print two copies. I’ll é a forma curta de I will e é muito usada no dia a dia.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “você pode me mandar?” e “eu mando agora”.
compare.us: Em inglês: Can you send it to me? I’ll send it now. Can you + verbo base, e I’ll + verbo base.

pages.title: A Vancouver beach · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon on a beach in Vancouver. Tall mountains stand behind the water. Dan sits on a log with his phone. His friend Yara walks over with two coffees. She sees a beautiful photo on his screen. She asks for a favor.
“Dan, that’s a great photo! Can you send it to me?” says Yara. “Sure! I’ll send it now. What’s your number?” says Dan. “It’s 555-0198. Can you also send it to my mom?” says Yara.
